notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS: enterprise knowledge product; search + answer UX central to roadmap.
- Current stack: Elasticsearch for recall + homegrown linear reranker (scores from tf-idf + feature weights). Looking to replace/augment with model-based reranker.
- Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first (fast path) then Dedicated for predictable latency & cost. POC goal: replace offline reranker stage and validate online latency.
- Reranking specifics: offline eval set ~25k labeled queries (curated), want offline scorer parity (NDCG@10 within 3%) before online canary. Also need feature compatibility: expose document metadata scores to reranker.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 rerank latency < 120ms for batch size 1 at 20 qps; peak throughput target 100 qps with batching. Cost sensitivity: medium-high — target per-query cost comparable to current infra.
- Model preferences: prefer open checkpoints that can be quantized; discussed using Llama2-13B-ish family or distilled reranker variants. Also interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization/batching.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), audit logs retention, KMS integration for keys, and EU data residency for some customers.
- POC plan (agreed):
  1) Offline evaluation: Redwood will run offline scoring on Embercrest eval set + provide parity report (NDCG, MRR, latency).
  2) Hosted API mini-POC: integrate prod recall -> Redwood reranker endpoint behind feature flag for 2% traffic. Observe online metrics and cost.
  3) Dedicated sizing & reserved pricing review: if hosted POC passes, move to dedicated pool for predictable throughput.
- Quotes: "Need to get to parity with our offline reranker before we can flip traffic" (Head of Search PM).
- Internal stakeholders: Head of Product (decision), VP Eng (cost + infra), Security (questionnaire), Finance (procurement).
- Notes on blockers: security questionnaire has two open items (KMS flow + audit export cadence). Finance wants 12-month committed pricing to see unit economics. SE ask: Redwood to provide sample offline scoring run within 7 business days.
- Ask from AE: submit dedicated sizing proposal + two pricing options (12m reserved, flexible monthly burst).
requirements_summary: Deliver model-based reranker with offline scoring parity (NDCG@10 within 3%), p95 <120ms for single-item rerank at 20 qps, scale to 100 qps with batching, integrate doc metadata features, SAML SSO + KMS + audit logs, EU residency for subset of data. Prefer open models for quantization; require guidance from Redwood Optimize on batching/quant profiles.
notes_short: Mid-market product team evaluating Hosted -> Dedicated. POC path: offline eval -> hosted canary -> dedicated. Main blockers: security questionnaire + pricing approval.
